text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- 350 billion escudos in pledges promised under the so-called Mateus Plan to help ailing firms repay tax and social security arrears, the newspaper learned.
- Spain to support the re-appointment for two years of Jose Cutileiro as secretary-general of the Western European Union, Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said yesterday.
- 1997 will be a good year for Banco Espirito Santo which announced a 21.3 percent increase year-on-year in 1996 profit to 23.593 billion escudos.
- Yesterday Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco warned that 1997 could be marked by exchange rate instability.
